text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis and organized body paragraphs","quality":"organization","description":"The essay presents ideas in a logical sequence with an introduction, separate supporting points, and a conclusion."},{"evidence":"topic sentence repeated for each reason","quality":"text structure","description":"The writing uses explicit paragraph-level structure to frame and extend each main idea."},{"evidence":"specific examples like \"older siblings or parents\" and \"classmates and teachers\"","quality":"elaboration","description":"The essay develops its claims with relevant examples rather than only stating opinions."},{"evidence":"mostly complete sentences with few breakdowns","quality":"sentence control","description":"The writing shows stronger control of sentence boundaries and grammatical form overall."},{"evidence":"consistent academic connectors like \"Another way\" and \"A final way\"","quality":"cohesion","description":"The essay uses transitional phrasing to link ideas smoothly across paragraphs."},{"evidence":"formal explanation of how opinions affect decisions","quality":"development of ideas","description":"The essay expands on its points with cause-and-effect reasoning that stays on task."}]}
